correctness.rationale: For each part, the update is all-zero, all-one or unchanged according to the strict sign of total ones outside that part minus half the degree. A uniform part can never become mixed. Two-step recurrence thus either uses uniform parts only, or leaves each mixed part tied both times. In the latter case all mixed parts have a common size j, the pure-zero and pure-one part numbers are equal, and (c-1)(j-q/2)=0. This yields exactly the cases and multinomial counts stated. The symmetric two-time energy with diagonal tie breakers proves no longer periodic orbits. Direct bit and independent weighted-profile programs checked full activity distributions across 21 and 34 parameter pairs.

value.rationale: The formula completely classifies every initially recurrent state of an infinite two-parameter family of equal-part Turán graphs, including flip-activity strata, a natural nonlinear dynamical invariant. A sharp structural difference occurs between odd and even part sizes: only one partial part can freeze at maximal activity for odd part count, whereas even part size allows several half-filled stationary parts and multiple lower-activity classes. For example r=5,q=4 has 4320 and 420 two-cycle configurations in distinct activity classes, despite the same graph structure being measured by both. The result is a meaningful benchmark for the influence of community parity on deterministic majority dynamics, not merely a numerical table.
